title: grainifier: real film grain measured from scans, applied to digital images
description: Open-source tool that measures film grain statistics (amplitude versus negative density, 2-D noise power spectrum, skewness) from linear scans of black-and-white negatives and renders that measured grain onto digital images in negative-density space. Includes profiles for Ilford HP5 Plus at EI 1600 and Kodak Double-X 5222 measured on a Nikon Coolscan V ED.
